title: Riptide
subtitle: Then, your life is handed over to the river, and you are forced to struggle against the current.

trails.title: The Price of Procrastination
trails.description: Constant delay will not make the piles of documents disappear—eventually, someone will have to deal with them.

content.text:
· First official exchange report with the School of Apeiron

Priority: Low, but please complete the registration of the arcanists from Apeiron as soon as possible. If the registration cannot be completed, please explain the reasons and provide relevant proof.

· A detailed report of Apeiron's operations on the island.

Priority: High, please prioritize completing the report on the joint operation with Zeno and a detailed account of Arcana's death.

· Complete the application for the ship "APPLe III" and explain of its specific purpose

Priority: Low, to be completed before the final deadline.

...

Priority: High, please submit a complete account of the event to assist in the multi-party evaluation of the arcanist, Jessica.

· Task handover procedures for Highway 77

Priority: Low, to be completed before the final deadline.

Priority: High, please submit a complete account of the event to assist in the multi-party evaluation of the arcanist, Tuesday.

Priority: High, please submit along with the above reports

items.text: Riptide
Zeno Base
A journey always starts with a farewell.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Here, put this on, Pera. It will allow me to track you should anything happen.
She fastens a small button to her sister's collar.
This button connects the two of them tightly. With this, they will always be able to find each other, no matter where they are.
They kiss on both cheeks.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: You'll remember to bring Father a souvenir this time, yes?

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: And promise me you'll be careful. I do not wish for our Pera to "buy the farm" just yet.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Don't worry about me, Molly. Worry about them.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: I'll kill them all, if I have to. Every last one.
She makes sure to emphasize the totality of her determination.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Alright, alright, enough blabbering. Do you two always share these little heart-to-hearts whenever you leave? I got nothing to say 'cept "bye."

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Or is the tortoise suddenly not so worried about its speed?
The ship signals its imminent departure.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Sotheby, do we have everything?

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Naturally! Ms. Sotheby is always ready to travel!

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: The ship is boarding now. After it departs, I will spend some time gathering intel on Mr. Duncan.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Thank you.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: We should be able to find him in the flesh once we get to town. Duncan and I go way back, hahaha!

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: And I'll introduce you to another friend. She lives in a bottle.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I'd be delighted to meet your friends.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: We should be going now.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Lilya, I've told Admiral Igor that he can rely on you for further assistance as necessary. Is that alright with you?

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Yeah, I'll do whatever needs doing.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Have a good trip!
Igor's Office
Having seen off their guests, Lieutenant Moldir returns to the admiral's office to report an incident from the previous night.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Admiral, a prisoner has gone missing from the tower.
She lowers her head as she awkwardly delivers her report.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: We'll make sure it's kept under wraps.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: The seal was broken, and we're still investigating who might have been involved.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: I did encounter the Timekeeper, Ms. Sotheby, and Lopera near the Tower yesterday. Still, I see no reason to suspect them.
They were the only people she saw near the tower yesterday.

items.speaker: Admiral Igor
items.text: The Timekeeper doesn't have any incentive, and Lopera—No, she wouldn't be involved.
Until last night, the tower held a single unlucky prisoner—a lamb to the slaughter, a stalk of wheat in autumn. But now she has gotten away.

items.speaker: Admiral Igor
items.text: Find the prisoner, but don't attempt recapture. Let's see who she's been in touch with.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Understood.

items.speaker: Admiral Igor
items.text: Lieutenant, this was a failure that must not be repeated.
He grits his teeth as he stares at the map before him. Zeno shouldn't be like this.
Aboard the "Alligator"
The ship departs, and before long, a dozen rowboats have surrounded it.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Oh, look at those strange cowboys! What are they doing with those hooks? Are they trying to hitch a ride?

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Yes, they will use those hooks to grab onto the side of the ship and moor their boats to ours.
Just as she said, the boats throw their hooks, latch onto the ship, and a number of people clamber aboard.
They're traders hawking homemade trinkets. Lopera politely declines them all.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Take this, Timekeeper.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: What's this?

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Just a map, in case we get separated.
The map is marked with at least three "safe routes."

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: This will show you the way from the harbor to the Veterans' Residence. Though, it can't show you the safest way. For that, you'll need me.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: But what am I saying? São Paulo is perfectly safe! That's what the politicians say anyways, never mind the talk of gangs, cartels, and greedy multinational corporations—pure slander.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Thank you for the warning, and the map. Let's hope I won't find any occasion to use it.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: I hope so, too. Well, we have a long cruise ahead. I'll leave you to your business. See you.
She waves goodbye, making her way through the energetic traders and to the other side of the deck.
The traders scamper around like little mice. Having made their sales, they're now scrambling to get a plate of food from the chef.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: So, the kitchen even prepares food for them.

items.speaker: Chef
items.text: No line-cutting! You, boy, back to your place!

items.speaker: Chef
items.text: Queue up, or there will be no dinner for you tonight!
The chef taps his metal spoon, sending the boy back to his place in the queue.
The boy sneakily grabs a few flatbreads, tucks them under his shirt, and scurries away.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Ah!
He bumps into Sotheby, crashing to the floor along with his "stolen goods."

items.speaker: Young Vendor
items.text: Ei, out of my way!
He stuffs the bread under his shirt again before running off. As he passes, Sotheby notices a glint of an arcane skill in his eyes.
He runs like a child enchanted by the Rattenfanger as he bolts toward a corner of the cabin.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Ms. Vertin? Did you notice that boy? Wasn't he awfully strange?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: You're right. Come on, let's go see what he's up to.
A woman hides in the shadows.
Her face is familiar, but she wears an entirely new outfit.
Is it really her? The lady at Tuesday's Motel?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: It's you!
The bread-stealing child is gone.
Instead, Ms. Kimberly is curled up in the corner, stuffing bread into her mouth with both hands.
She stops and looks up, surprise in her eyes.

items.speaker: Ms. Kimberly
items.text: Mm?! Oh, Vertin?

items.speaker: Ms. Kimberly
items.text: How—What are you doing here?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I was about to ask you the very same question.
The farewell at Tuesday's Motel last month wasn't exactly pleasant.
But she looks starved now.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Is this a new friend, Vertin? A pleasure to meet you!
Sotheby approaches, but Kimberly looks terrified. She freezes, a sticky lump of dough dropping from the corner of her mouth.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Please, take this.
She offers her a chocolate bar. After a moment's hesitation, Kimberly swallows, grabs the bar, and shoves it into her mouth.

items.speaker: Ms. Kimberly
items.text: Th-Thank you ...
She licks her fingers clean like a ravenous child.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Have you found what you lost since we last met?
Her face falls. It appears not.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Perhaps I could help.

items.speaker: Ms. Kimberly
items.text: Thank you, but I would prefer to do this on my own.

items.speaker: Ms. Kimberly
items.text: I was the one who lost it, and I will be the one to get it back.
She's unwilling to cooperate, but there's no hostility.
A strange and contradictory figure, an arcanist who seems to be on the verge of reformation.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: This ship is headed to São Paulo. Is that where you're heading as well? Would you like to accompany us?

items.speaker: Ms. Kimberly
items.text: São Paulo? I don't ...
It's the ship's only destination. Where else could she go?

items.speaker: Ms. Kimberly
items.text: There isn't anything for me there. Only a pit of misery and pain. There's no more dancing, no feasts or banquets. No—
Her eyes dart away.
"There's nothing there."

items.speaker: Ms. Kimberly
items.text: No, I would rather we simply part ways here, Ms. Vertin! Farewell, and pleasant journeys—I'm indebted to you for your kindness.

items.speaker: Ms. Kimberly
items.text: Ah, and your friend here ... Aren't you just a sweetheart? Oh, I could just gobble you up for tea!
She reaches out and pinches Sotheby's cheek.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Ah! Madam, please. You ... This simply isn't proper or ladylike.
Kimberly smiles, as if she has shed the baggage of their previous encounter, and disappears into the crowd.
There's an old legend told in the desert peninsula: encountering a demon is always a sign of bad things to come.
TO BE CONTINUED…
